name: Channel Lab
description: A browser ionosonde: transmit a 1-second 300–2700 Hz chirp, matched-filter the return, and see the channel's impulse response — one orange needle per propagation path, spacing in milliseconds, RMS delay spread computed. Point it at the sky, a wire, or the 🧪 conditions simulator to watch what the channel does to every other mode.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
